Choose the AI question you most want the course to answer.

Play two tapping rounds, first on your own and then with an AI multiplier.

Set up a free ChatGPT account and review basic privacy settings.
Create a superhero scene, then ask AI to revise its ending.

Play Twenty Questions with ChatGPT using an object and then an abstract idea.
Review the clues you supplied and how its questions narrowed the possibilities.

Sort incoming statements by whether you can control them.
Watch the stress meter rise when you make a mistake.

Decide what your own knowledge reveals and what needs an outside check.

Upload the course packet to Gemini Notebook and generate a quiz.

Upload messy planning notes to Gemini Notebook.
Summarize the main argument, edits, and a joke, then check the crossed-out ideas and replacements against the original.

Judge whether example tasks match one of AI's strengths.
See why the same tool can fit one job better than another.

Match AI app names with the stories behind those names.
Use the matches to learn the major tools in the course.

Ask AI a leading question, then rewrite it as a stronger question.
Compare the answers to see how wording steers the result.

Assign points to an essay rubric and judge the essay yourself.

Create a ChatGPT project for the next coding activity.

Review AI answers and choose whether each is ready to use or needs checking.

Read everyday claims and identify the problem with each one.
Practice applying critical thinking to AI output.

Choose which answers a pretend Kitchen Helper should favor.

Guess how many tokens different text examples contain.

Use sentence clues to identify what a marked word refers to.

Use ChatGPT to build a version of the dinosaur jumping game.

Generate images and look for sameness in who or what appears.

Calculate how daily time in a favorite app adds up over a year.

Choose the role AI should play in five increasingly serious situations.
